title: Every Space, free included, can download its own stock QR code, which is not editable

source.ref: owner QR ruling 2026-10-06 16:48 in the pricing ladder thread (ADR-1709 follow-on)

detail: OWNER RULING 2026-10-06: "Free Account: Stock, no edit QR code. Can download. Business: 3 Dynamic QR codes. Collective: 5 Dynamic QR codes per entity. Non Profit: 5 Dynamic QR codes per entity." LIVE-748 sets the managed (dynamic) code meter to free 0, Business 3, Collective and Non Profit 5. THE CONSEQUENCE this row fixes: a free Space's QR settings page refuses every code and offers nothing, while the ruling promises it a stock code. THE FIX: the Space QR settings page (app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/qr/qr-body.tsx) always shows the Space's own stock QR code, pointing at its public page, with PNG and SVG download, and no edit, splash or retarget controls. It is not a managed code, so it never counts against space_qr. Shown on every plan, above the editable codes. Once it ships, the free refusal in lib/qr/space-codes.ts points at it.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const c=r("components/qr/space-stock-qr.tsx");if(!c)fail("no stock Space QR component yet");if(!/download/i.test(c))fail("the stock Space QR cannot be downloaded");if(!r("app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/qr/qr-body.tsx").includes("SpaceStockQr"))fail("the Space QR page does not show the stock code");if(!/download/i.test(r("lib/qr/space-codes.ts").split("Editable QR codes come with Business")[1]?.slice(0,200)||""))fail("the free refusal does not point at the stock download");console.log("ok: every Space can download its stock QR code")'
